test_cases.description: Verify that after completion of the PIVT LRU Basic Test with LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault set to True, the LRU software transmits IVT_Receipt_Envelope (0x0020) and IVT_Receipt_Content (0x0001) to LRU2 over the STL Bus.
test_cases.initial_condition: LRU software idle, PIVT LRU Basic Test not yet executed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Execute PIVT LRU Basic Test with LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault = True.
test_cases.expected_result: IVT_Receipt_Envelope = 0x0020 and IVT_Receipt_Content = 0x0001 transmitted over STL Bus.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Transmission occurs immediately after test completion and matches the expected values.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Monitor STL Bus traffic to confirm envelope and content values.

test_cases.description: Verify that after completion of the PIVT LRU Basic Test with LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault set to False, the LRU software transmits IVT_Receipt_Envelope (0x0020) and IVT_Receipt_Content (0x0000) to LRU2 over the STL Bus.
test_cases.initial_condition: LRU software idle, PIVT LRU Basic Test not yet executed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Execute PIVT LRU Basic Test with LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault = False.
test_cases.expected_result: IVT_Receipt_Envelope = 0x0020 and IVT_Receipt_Content = 0x0000 transmitted over STL Bus.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Transmission occurs immediately after test completion and matches the expected values.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Monitor STL Bus traffic to confirm envelope and content values.

test_cases.description: Verify that IVT_Receipt_Envelope and IVT_Receipt_Content retain the previously transmitted value until a new PIVT result is available for transmission.
test_cases.initial_condition: Previous PIVT LRU Basic Test completed with LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault = True, resulting in IVT_Receipt_Content = 0x0001.
test_cases.test_inputs: Start a new PIVT LRU Basic Test with LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault = False but do not complete the test.
test_cases.expected_result: IVT_Receipt_Envelope remains 0x0020 and IVT_Receipt_Content remains 0x0001 until the new test completes.
test_cases.pass_criteria: No change in envelope or content values observed during the new test execution prior to completion.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Observe STL Bus traffic during the new test to confirm that no new transmission occurs until test completion.

test_cases.description: Verify that IVT_Receipt_Envelope and IVT_Receipt_Content faults are cleared during power‑up initialization.
test_cases.initial_condition: System powered up and initialization sequence executed.
test_cases.test_inputs: None (observe system state after power‑up).
test_cases.expected_result: IVT_Receipt_Envelope = 0x0020 and IVT_Receipt_Content = 0x0000 indicating faults cleared.
test_cases.pass_criteria: After power‑up, no fault values are present in the envelope or content.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Check the values of IVT_Receipt_Envelope and IVT_Receipt_Content immediately after power‑up.

test_cases.description: Verify that IVT_Receipt_Envelope and IVT_Receipt_Content faults are cleared upon entry into PIVT Test Suite 2.
test_cases.initial_condition: System in idle state with previous fault values present.
test_cases.test_inputs: Command entry into PIVT Test Suite 2.
test_cases.expected_result: IVT_Receipt_Envelope = 0x0020 and IVT_Receipt_Content = 0x0000 indicating faults cleared.
test_cases.pass_criteria: After entering Test Suite 2, no fault values are present in the envelope or content.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Verify the values of IVT_Receipt_Envelope and IVT_Receipt_Content immediately after entering Test Suite 2.

test_cases.description: Verify that IVT_Receipt_Envelope and IVT_Receipt_Content faults are cleared upon exit from IVT mode as commanded by IVT_Active_STL.
test_cases.initial_condition: System in IVT mode with previous fault values present.
test_cases.test_inputs: Command exit from IVT mode via IVT_Active_STL.
test_cases.expected_result: IVT_Receipt_Envelope = 0x0020 and IVT_Receipt_Content = 0x0000 indicating faults cleared.
test_cases.pass_criteria: After exiting IVT mode, no fault values are present in the envelope or content.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Check the values of IVT_Receipt_Envelope and IVT_Receipt_Content immediately after exiting IVT mode.

test_cases.description: Verify that the LRU software repeats the RAM Memory test exactly once when the initial RAM Memory test fails.
test_cases.initial_condition: System initialized; RAM Memory test has not yet been executed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulate a failure condition during the first execution of the RAM Memory test.
test_cases.expected_result: The RAM Memory test is executed a second time immediately after the failure.
test_cases.pass_criteria: The repeat count of the RAM Memory test equals 1 and no additional repeats occur.

test_cases.description: Verify that the LRU software does not repeat the RAM Memory test when the initial test passes.
test_cases.initial_condition: System initialized; RAM Memory test has not yet been executed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulate a successful execution of the RAM Memory test.
test_cases.expected_result: The RAM Memory test is not repeated after a successful pass.
test_cases.pass_criteria: The repeat count of the RAM Memory test equals 0.

test_cases.description: Verify that RAM_Fault_GndOp is set to TRUE when RAM Memory Test fails after the second attempt.
test_cases.initial_condition: RAM Memory Test has been attempted twice and both attempts have failed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulate two consecutive failures of the RAM Memory Test.
test_cases.expected_result: RAM_Fault_GndOp should be set to TRUE.
test_cases.pass_criteria: RAM_Fault_GndOp equals TRUE after the second failure.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Ensure that the test harness triggers the RAM Memory Test failure condition on both attempts and verifies the flag after the second attempt.

test_cases.description: Verify that IVT_Receipt_Envelope and IVT_Receipt_Content are sent when RAM_Fault_GndOp is True and Translation_Fault_GndOp is False.
test_cases.initial_condition: LRU software initialized with no fault flags set.
test_cases.test_inputs: Set RAM_Fault_GndOp to True; set Translation_Fault_GndOp to False.
test_cases.expected_result: LRU sends IVT_Receipt_Envelope (0x0020) and IVT_Receipt_Content (0x0001); LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault flag is set to True.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Message queue contains the two expected messages and LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault is True.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: 1. Initialize LRU. 2. Inject RAM_Fault_GndOp True. 3. Observe message transmission and flag status.

test_cases.description: Verify that IVT_Receipt_Envelope and IVT_Receipt_Content are sent when Translation_Fault_GndOp is True and RAM_Fault_GndOp is False.
test_cases.initial_condition: LRU software initialized with no fault flags set.
test_cases.test_inputs: Set RAM_Fault_GndOp to False; set Translation_Fault_GndOp to True.
test_cases.expected_result: LRU sends IVT_Receipt_Envelope (0x0020) and IVT_Receipt_Content (0x0001); LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault flag is set to True.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Message queue contains the two expected messages and LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault is True.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: 1. Initialize LRU. 2. Inject Translation_Fault_GndOp True. 3. Observe message transmission and flag status.

test_cases.description: Verify that IVT_Receipt_Envelope and IVT_Receipt_Content are sent when both RAM_Fault_GndOp and Translation_Fault_GndOp are True.
test_cases.initial_condition: LRU software initialized with no fault flags set.
test_cases.test_inputs: Set RAM_Fault_GndOp to True; set Translation_Fault_GndOp to True.
test_cases.expected_result: LRU sends IVT_Receipt_Envelope (0x0020) and IVT_Receipt_Content (0x0001); LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault flag is set to True.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Message queue contains the two expected messages and LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault is True.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: 1. Initialize LRU. 2. Inject both fault flags True. 3. Observe message transmission and flag status.

test_cases.description: Verify that no IVT_Receipt_Envelope or IVT_Receipt_Content is sent when both RAM_Fault_GndOp and Translation_Fault_GndOp are False.
test_cases.initial_condition: LRU software initialized with no fault flags set.
test_cases.test_inputs: Set RAM_Fault_GndOp to False; set Translation_Fault_GndOp to False.
test_cases.expected_result: LRU does not send IVT_Receipt_Envelope or IVT_Receipt_Content; LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault flag remains False.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Message queue contains no such messages and LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault is False.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: 1. Initialize LRU. 2. Ensure both fault flags are False. 3. Verify absence of messages and flag status.

test_cases.description: Verify that setting LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault to True results in sending IVT_Receipt_Envelope and IVT_Receipt_Content.
test_cases.initial_condition: LRU software initialized with no fault flags set.
test_cases.test_inputs: Set LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault to True.
test_cases.expected_result: LRU sends IVT_Receipt_Envelope (0x0020) and IVT_Receipt_Content (0x0001).
test_cases.pass_criteria: Message queue contains the two expected messages.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: 1. Initialize LRU. 2. Inject LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault True. 3. Observe message transmission.

test_cases.description: Verify that LRU sends IVT_Receipt_Envelope (0x0020) and IVT_Receipt_Content (0x0000) when both RAM_Fault_GndOp and Translation_Fault_GndOp are False.
test_cases.initial_condition: RAM_Fault_GndOp = False, Translation_Fault_GndOp = False
test_cases.test_inputs: Set RAM_Fault_GndOp to False and Translation_Fault_GndOp to False
test_cases.expected_result: LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault = False; IVT_Receipt_Envelope (0x0020) and IVT_Receipt_Content (0x0000) are transmitted
test_cases.pass_criteria: Receipt of IVT_Receipt_Envelope (0x0020) and IVT_Receipt_Content (0x0000) confirms correct behavior

test_cases.description: Verify that LRU does not send IVT_Receipt_Envelope and IVT_Receipt_Content when either RAM_Fault_GndOp or Translation_Fault_GndOp is True.
test_cases.initial_condition: RAM_Fault_GndOp = True, Translation_Fault_GndOp = False
test_cases.test_inputs: Set RAM_Fault_GndOp to True and Translation_Fault_GndOp to False (or vice versa)
test_cases.expected_result: No IVT_Receipt_Envelope (0x0020) or IVT_Receipt_Content (0x0000) is transmitted
test_cases.pass_criteria: Absence of IVT_Receipt_Envelope and IVT_Receipt_Content confirms correct behavior

test_cases.description: Verify RAM write and read back of pattern 0x55555555 across all test blocks.
test_cases.initial_condition: RAM contents are unknown prior to test execution.
test_cases.test_inputs: Write 0x55555555 to each address in the defined test blocks.
test_cases.expected_result: Reading back from each address returns 0x55555555.
test_cases.pass_criteria: All read values match the written pattern 0x55555555.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: The RAM test is invasive and does not include the OFP program memory.

test_cases.description: Verify walking address test by writing each address value into its own location across all test blocks.
